questions.question: When may you stop in a motorway emergency area?
options: Only in an emergency or breakdown
To read a map or take a phone call
To let passengers stretch their legs
questions.explanation: Emergency areas are strictly for emergencies and breakdowns.

questions.question: Should you place a warning triangle on a motorway if you break down?
options: No, never place a warning triangle on a motorway
questions.explanation: Never place a warning triangle on a motorway because high-speed traffic makes it unsafe.
